name: The Glass Butterfly Conservatory
description: A stunning greenhouse filled with thousands of glass butterflies, each one a unique work of stained glass, fluttering silently among real, exotic plants.
prompt: A vibrant and delicate scene inside a large, Victorian-style glass conservatory. Sunlight streams through the glass ceiling, illuminating thousands of unique, hand-crafted stained glass butterflies of all sizes and colors—deep crimson, royal blue, sunny yellow, emerald green. The butterflies flutter gracefully through the humid air, their translucent wings catching and refracting the light into dazzling rainbows on the tiled floor. Real, lush tropical plants with broad green leaves and colorful orchids grow in wrought-iron planters. The scene is a perfect blend of fragility and beauty. Highly detailed digital painting with a focus on light refraction and the interplay of glass and nature.
caption: Fragility and flight, art and nature intertwined. Each flutter is a brushstroke in a living masterpiece. 🦋🎨
